falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would falsify the transition_2020_dec_breakout pattern match, as that pattern featured declining volatility and controlled pullbacks; sustained fear with meaningful downside would indicate a regime change to risk-off, invalidating the bullish breakout analog

falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals a flight-to-safety/liquidity-stress dynamic inconsistent with the 2020 breakout pattern, which occurred alongside reflationary conditions (rising yields, weaker dollar); it would indicate macro headwinds overriding the technical setup, falsifying the current verdict

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
